data.title: Germany arrests ex-spy chief on suspicion of giving secrets to foreign powers
data.description: BERLIN - A former German spy chief was arrested Tuesday on suspicion of passing sensitive information to foreign powers, an embarrassing case that comes as the country is seeking to bolster its intelligence agencies.

data.title: IMF warns cost-of-living shocks cause 'lasting deterioration' in affordability
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - The International Monetary Fund warned Tuesday that price increases for necessities like food and energy, fuelled by the wars in Iran and Ukraine, were more persistent than previously expected.

data.title: World Bank forecasts modest growth for Latin America, highlights climate risks
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - The World Bank on Tuesday forecast modest economic growth in Latin America and the Caribbean, warning that risks from high energy prices and the climate phenomenon El Nino could impact the region.

data.title: Nómada fires up first Friday with feast and fiesta
data.description: Nómada Open Fire Grill & Beach Club at Dusit Thani Hua Hin just launched 'Nómada Fiesta', a new monthly dining experience bringing together the bold flavours, lively rhythms and warm, convivial spirit of South America.

data.title: Nobel physics prize honours work on 'ghostly messengers' from outer space
data.description: STOCKHOLM - Belgian physicist Francis Halzen on Tuesday won the Nobel physics prize for groundbreaking work using South Pole ice to capture particles originating in the distant cosmos, providing insight into the far reaches of space.

data.title: Bulgaria searches for missing crew after drones hit two more ships in Black Sea
data.description: SOFIA (BULGARIA) - Bulgarian authorities launched a major search on Tuesday for the missing crew of a ship that sank in the Black Sea after drones hit two vessels in what the prime minister slammed as an "absolutely unacceptable" attack.

data.title: Kenya reports first-ever Ebola death
data.description: NAIROBI - Kenya has reported its first-ever Ebola death, the health minister announced on Tuesday, after a Kenyan man who had been living in the Democratic Republic of Congo died after returning to the country.

data.title: Myanmar leader to visit Malaysia after migrant returns begin
data.description: KUALA LUMPUR - Myanmar's coup leader turned president Min Aung Hlaing will head to Malaysia on Wednesday for a two-day visit, officials said, following Kuala Lumpur's plan to return thousands of Myanmar immigrants.

data.title: Germany's AfD poised to preside over state assembly for first time
data.description: MAGDEBURG (GERMANY) - The far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) prepared Tuesday to preside over a state assembly for the first time following its landslide election victory in the eastern state of Saxony-Anhalt.

data.title: Le Pen vows drastic cost savings to prevent French 'default'
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - French far-right presidential candidate Marine Le Pen said Tuesday that she would implement 140 billion euros (US$157 billion) in cost savings by 2032 if elected next year, warning that without change France was "heading towards default" on its debt.

data.title: Lisa’s LLOUD launches Von Dutch Hollywood’s first collaboration online Oct 6
data.description: Lisa’s LLOUD collection marks Von Dutch Hollywood’s first collaboration, following its debut at ComplexCon in Los Angeles on October 3–4.

data.title: The Royal Oak is now a necklace
data.description: Audemars Piguet reinterprets the iconic Royal Oak signature band in a high jewellery collection adorned with diamonds and precious stones, bringing together the worlds of horology and haute joaillerie.

data.title: Nene Royal makes voice-acting debut in Disney's 'Hexed'
data.description: Nene Royal, the 16-year-old Thai rocker who won America's Got Talent 2026, will make her acting debut as the Thai voice of Billie Doe, the lead character in Disney's Hexed.

data.title: 'Eats through a straw': French teens wounded in high school protests
data.description: PARIS — Several children have been seriously injured during protests in France, as high school pupils demand better conditions and police crack down on their demonstrations.

data.title: Yemen's Houthis claim attack on Riyadh airport, deny losing territory
data.description: SANAA — Yemen's Houthis claimed an attack on the main airport in the Saudi capital while also denying on Tuesday losing territory to government forces, as fighting intensified.

data.title: Substation storm fire causes Nong Chok blackout
data.description: A high-voltage substation of the Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand caught fire in Nong Chok district of Bangkok during heavy rain on Tuesday.

data.title: Disease control chief allays plague concern in Russia
data.description: The Department of Disease Control (DDC) says there is no evidence of a plague outbreak in Russia and considers the risk of transmission to Thailand to be low.

data.title: Nene Royal makes Thai voice debut in Disney’s Hexed opening Nov 26
data.description: Thailand’s Nene Royal takes on the challenge of portraying a young witch’s emotions in Disney’s Hexed, opening in cinemas on November 26.

data.title: Thai actors top fashion week global metric charts
data.description: For years, the global fashion-week front row seemed to belong to a familiar club: Hollywood actors, supermodels and K-pop idols whose every appearance could trigger a spike in online conversation. But coming in hot this season is the rise of Thai celebrities in the global spotlight of this Fall's fashion weeks.

data.title: All rise for Blue's return
data.description: The pop quartet — Antony Costa, Duncan James, Lee Ryan and Simon Webbe — will return to Bangkok next January for their 25th Anniversary Asia Tour. Their third concert in Thailand is part of the second leg of their Asia tour.

data.title: Salad Factory Partners with USDA to Launch "Taste of USA" Campaign
data.description: Salad Factory is partnering with the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) and the U.S. Embassy in Thailand to launch the "Taste of USA" campaign. The campaign was officially launched by Mr. Piya Dankum , Chief Executive Officer of Green Food Factory Co., Ltd., and Mr. Victorino “Mayo” Floro IV , Regional Agricultural Attaché, USDA/U.S. Embassy Bangkok. It invites Thai consumers to discover the quality and flavors of ingredients from across the United States, including Alaska, through seven dishes developed by the Salad Factory culinary team. Each dish highlights the qualities of its featured ingredient while reflecting the brand's signature style.

data.title: The alleged murder by US Marine on Okinawa: five things to know
data.description: TOKYO - A woman's murder allegedly committed by a US Marine in Okinawa has triggered public outrage, prompted Japan's premier to slam a "heinous crime" and rekindled controversy over the heavy military presence on the southern island.

data.title: Aura Bangkok Clinic takes T-Beauty global with the world’s 1st airport-based aesthetic clinic
data.description: BANGKOK —Sept 15, 2026 — Aura Wellness Public Co Ltd, the holding company behind Aura Bangkok Clinic, Aura Xpress Clinic and AURASOL, today confirmed that its flagship brand, Aura Bangkok Clinic, has opened the world's first aesthetic clinic to operate beyond immigration inside an international airport departure hall, in the Departure Hall at Suvarnabhumi airport’s Concourse G. For Aura Wellness, the opening marks a milestone in its broader strategy to establish Thailand as the world’s leading beauty and wellness destination, rather than simply one of several options for travellers.

data.title: New China-Laos training centre could be Chinese military base
data.description: BEIJING — A China-Laos centre that opened last week near Vientiane to train Laotian air force pilots has sparked speculation among observers that it could be used as an overseas Chinese military base.

data.title: Moscow denies sanitary measures over plague reports
data.description: MOSCOW - Russian authorities denied on Tuesday that special restrictions had been introduced over reports that a laboratory technician died of plague, even as Washington said it was closely monitoring events.

data.title: MiVana Launches Organic Coffee Cherry 'Shot Drink' to Tap Into Wellness Market
data.description: MiVana Company Limited, part of the Premier Group, has launched MiVana SHOT DRINK, a ready-to-drink wellness beverage made from organic coffee cherry pulp sourced from watershed forests in the northern province of Chiang Rai. The launch expands the company’s business beyond organic coffee into the wellness market, with a sales target of 100 million baht in the first 12 months .

data.title: Bangkok Central Kitchen brings healthy meals to 150,000 students
data.description: "Bangkok, City for Better Health" launched a "Central Kitchen" at Wat Don School, enabling the preparation of nutritious meals for almost 1,500 students across seven schools in the Sathon and Bang Rak districts.

data.title: Leaders visit Pacific's Tuvalu on frontline of climate change
data.description: FUNAFUTI (TUVALU) - More than a dozen leaders visited the tiny Pacific nation of Tuvalu on Tuesday for a brief look at a once-vibrant ecosystem wiped out due to climate change.

data.title: South Korea warns of possible AI use in banking hacks
data.description: SEOUL — Artificial intelligence (AI) may have been used in a string of cyberattacks targeting South Korea's financial sector, the president said Tuesday, as police announced the launch of an investigation.

data.title: End of an era as Messi prepares to hang up Argentina boots
data.description: BUENOS AIRES - Lionel Messi will pull on Argentina's sky blue-and-white jersey for the last time on Tuesday and enjoy an emotional farewell in front of his adoring fans in a stadium with a name to match his legacy: Monumental.

data.title: Purple reign: Philippines seeks to keep grip on ube throne
data.description: PADRE GARCIA — The Philippine ube has become a trend-setting sensation from Los Angeles (LA) to London to Seoul, with the humble yam's bright purple hue drawing lines outside coffee shops and bakeries and millions of views on social media.

data.title: Myanmar leader to visit Malaysia after migrant returns begin
data.description: KUALA LUMPUR — Myanmar's coup leader turned president Min Aung Hlaing will visit Malaysia "in the next few days", Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said Tuesday, after Kuala Lumpur launched a plan to return thousands of Myanmar migrants.

data.title: Central Plains floods easing, risk moving South
data.description: Floods contiue to dominate parts of Bangkok and 27 provinces, mostly in the Central Plains, but the risk is moving southwards with the approach of the annual northeast monsoon.
